messages:
Maya: FYI CS just escalated a month-end mismatch for AcmeInc — invoice total is ~11,482 higher than the dashboard for 2024-02 EOM. They attached invoice lines, looks like a bunch of tokens showing up under namespace 'acme-legacy' on the invoice but dashboard groups under 'acme-main'.

Tasha: Customer report: dashboard (UI) shows total = $24,130 but invoice = $35,612. They did a quick grep and noticed ~8k tokens attributed to `namespace:acme-legacy` on the invoice export.

Samir: Did we change any namespace/tagging mapping in ingestion recently? I remember a mapping tweak in nightly-shipper earlier this month.

dev-bot: nightly-agg v2024.02.27 deployed to prod at 2024-02-28T02:10Z. Change: preserve incoming "namespace" tag when fallback-org is present.

Leo: That sounds like it — if the billing pipeline preserved an old raw namespace but the dashboard UI applies the canonical org->namespace mapping, counts could be split across two buckets. Need quick repro: query raw events vs canonical aggregation for that period.

Maya: I'm attaching the invoice export snippet they sent (redacted customer id). Invoice lines: `acme-main` $24,130, `acme-legacy` $11,482. Dashboard shows `acme-main` $24,130 only.

Samir: Quick SQL to compare:
```sql
-- raw events (pre-mapping)
SELECT raw_namespace, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM billing_raw.events
WHERE period = '2024-02-29'
  AND customer_id = 'redacted_acme'
GROUP BY raw_namespace
ORDER BY tokens DESC;

-- canonical aggregated view
SELECT canonical_namespace, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM billing_agg.namespace_rollup
WHERE period = '2024-02-29'
  AND customer_id = 'redacted_acme'
GROUP BY canonical_namespace
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```

Tasha: Running now on staging replica, will paste results.

billing-bot: aggregation-job for period=2024-02-29 completed in 42s (rows: 7,812, errors: 0).

Tasha: Staging query results: raw_namespace: `acme-legacy` -> 1,149,823 tokens (cost ~$11.5k). canonical_namespace: `acme-main` -> 2,412,987 tokens (cost ~$24.1k). canonical view has no entry for `acme-legacy`.

Samir: Okay that confirms raw events were left under legacy tag while canonical rollup folded those events into acme-main for dashboard, but invoice pipeline used raw_namespace for line items. Two different pipelines picking different namespace sources.

Maya: Any quick patch? Customer wants corrected invoice or a credit.

Leo: Short-term: we can regenerate invoice lines by running invoice job with canonical mapping applied (same logic as dashboard namespace canonicalization). I can run a manual invoice re-run for that customer for the month if we have a signed credit request.

Samir: For fix: modify invoice pipeline to pull namespace from billing_agg.namespace_rollup (or apply same transform) instead of raw_namespace. Risk: deploy touches invoice job; need rollout plan.

dev-bot: staging job "invoice-generator" v1.8.4 available. Diff: use canonical_namespace in line generation when present.

Samir: Low-risk rollout steps: 1) run invoice-generator v1.8.4 on a dry-run for affected accounts and diff totals; 2) run acceptance tests (we have suites for tier logic); 3) deploy to prod behind feature-flag; 4) re-run historical invoices for affected accounts only after sign-off.

Tasha: Triage notes for CS: told Acme we'll investigate; asking for permission to issue provisional credit pending manual re-run.

Maya: CS requested exact repro steps so they can confirm with Acme: include the SQL and note that the invoice pipeline was using raw_namespace prior to 2024-02-28 deploy.

Leo: I'll own the manual re-run if finance approves. Samir, can you open a PR with the change and include test vectors showing canonical mapping fixes?

Samir: On it. PR will include regression tests and an integration test using the attached invoice snippet. ETA for draft PR: 3 hours.

Tasha: Customer wants timeline; CS will offer 48-72h turnaround for credit + regenerated invoice if we get approval today.

Maya: Action items: [Samir] PR + feature flag; [Leo] manual re-run once PR merged and finance ack; [Tasha] confirm customer permission for provisional credit; [Maya] coordinate finance & billing ops.

billing-bot: created incident INC-2024-2113 to track invoice discrepancy for customer redacted_acme.

Samir: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/492 — description: fallback to canonical_namespace for invoice lines; includes test vectors. Please review.

Leo: Reviewed, LGTM. Will queue manual invoice re-run after merge.

Tasha: Customer accepted provisional credit, wants updated invoice PDF after re-run. Noted.

Maya: Closing loop here — please paste final confirmation when credit applied and new invoice sent.

Samir: Merged and toggled feature flag in prod (off by default). Ran dry-run for redacted_acme, totals match dashboard now. Preparing to flip flag for this customer only for manual re-run.

dev-bot: feature-flag toggle recorded: invoice_canonical_namespace=true for account=redacted_acme by Samir at 2024-03-01T18:42Z.

Leo: Manual re-run completed. New invoice total $24,130. Credit of $11,482 applied. Sent PDF to Acme billing contact.

Tasha: Customer confirmed receipt and acceptance. Issue resolved from their side :white_check_mark:.

Maya: Great. Follow-ups: 1) schedule rollout of canonical mapping to all invoices (prod feature flag off for broader rollout until tests pass); 2) add alert to reconcile invoice vs dashboard totals >2% at EOM; 3) doc the mapping divergence in runbook.

Samir: I'll open follow-up tickets for 1 & 2. Thanks team.

Maya: Thanks everyone.
